justification: Inspected `javaparser-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/Range.java` and `javaparser-core-testing/src/test/java/com/github/javaparser/RangeTest.java`. `Range` is a compact immutable value type with only two fields (`begin`, `end`) and a single cohesive responsibility: source-span handling via construction, copying (`withBegin*`/`withEnd*`), containment/overlap/order checks, equality/hash/toString, and `getLineCount()`. The test file exercises this same narrow concern set extensively, and I found no separate state or unrelated behavior that would indicate insufficient modularization.
